column5: rationale
Package-manager dependency trees are not Nimbus-owned source.
Cargo build artifacts are not source.
Bundled build outputs are verified by package/build gates, not source-size gates.
Storybook static bundles are generated UI artifacts.
Local Nimbus app artifacts are generated.
Convex generated API/data model outputs are regenerated from source.
Generated protobuf/client sources are tracked output, not hand-owned logic.
Imported Node compatibility fixtures are evidence corpus, not Nimbus-owned source.
Browser demo vendor bundle is third-party/generated artifact.
Proof screenshots and evidence artifacts are not source modules.

Embedded assets are build-output/vendored copies (codegen bundle, esbuild lib, generated protobuf .d.ts, built package files); owned sources live in packages/ or upstream. Added 2026-07-04 (arch-review gate restoration).
Provider-scoped SQL builder module; rename to a concept-owned name (query_builder/sql) when next touched. Added 2026-07-04.
Provider-scoped SQL builder module; rename to a concept-owned name when next touched. Added 2026-07-04.
Test monolith (hard threshold); decompose into concept-owned case modules like tests/node/cases. Queued 2026-07-04.
Generated-style watchpoint case corpus (hard threshold); split by watchpoint family or justify as corpus. Queued 2026-07-04.

Custom-harness bench module (harness = false) that holds ten post-PIR scenario groups sharing one trace schema family and fixture set; it is scenario code, not a separable data table, and it never ships. Split by scenario group when a group is next extended.
Node-compat harness root (hard threshold); split harness vs case registration. Queued 2026-07-04.

Custom-harness bench root (harness = false) that owns the shared pool-mode fixtures, host bridge, and criterion registration for its post_pir child; it never ships. Move fixtures into concept-owned bench children when the root is next extended.
Spec-suite runner mirrors the external DynamoDB spec corpus ordering; splitting would decouple it from the spec index. Review band.
Server test root should shed concept-owned modules as it grows. Review band, watch on next touch.
Query behavior suite; single coherent ownership story (query evaluation); split by operator family when next extended. Review band.
Service-manager integration suite remains one lifecycle-and-channel contract; split by behavior family if it approaches the hard threshold.
Limits suite; coherent (resource limits). Review band.
CRUD+journal suite; the atomicity invariant tests belong together. Review band.
Test-runtime render op. Review band.
Cooperative-scheduling suite; coherent story. Review band.
Deploy command; candidate for stage-owned modules (bundle/upload/activate) when next touched. Review band.
Queued-journal behavior suite owns enqueue, batching, admission, and response contracts; split by those concepts when next extended.
Publisher-observer suite is one ordered-publication observation contract; keep test seams colocated while below the hard threshold.

Recovery/crash matrix intentionally keeps durable, applied, and published-prefix scenarios together so shared deterministic fault seams cannot drift; hard-threshold exception reviewed during PPSC closeout.
Atomic execution-unit behavior suite keeps staging, commit, replay, cancellation, and error invariants on one production interface.

PPSC production-interface runner and core embedded contract suite; U8 extracted seed-farm artifact lifecycle and cross-backend differential comparison into concept-owned modules, leaving this review-band root below the hard threshold with one scenario-orchestration ownership story.
Local blob-store backend owns one filesystem-backed BlobStore implementation; candidate split is lifecycle versus range/read operations when next touched.

Pre-existing review-band pure policy-decision interface owns rule validation, canonical authority matching, authorization results, and its fail-closed unit contract; unchanged by PPSC U8 and below the hard threshold.
Cohesive PostgreSQL transaction surface; U6 moved cross-dialect batching and pipeline policy into sql/write_pipeline.rs and the PostgreSQL adapter, leaving this root below the hard threshold.
Cohesive MySQL transaction surface; U6 moved cross-dialect batching and packet planning into concept-owned modules, leaving this root below the hard threshold.
Host-bridge behavior suite owns one runtime boundary; split by database, scheduler, and capability families when next extended.
Projection unit suite keeps provenance, ordering, and replay invariants together on the projection interface.
Projection work owner coordinates durable claim, fenced publication, and recovery; child modules own provider-specific persistence details.
Decision-log phase suite is one policy/audit contract; split by phase family if it grows further.
HTTPS interception suite owns one end-to-end trust and policy boundary; it crossed the hard threshold, so split by interception phase (handshake, leaf issuance, policy decision) when next touched.
Durable-journal and replica consistency suite; split journal reload, cursor streaming, and embedded-replica parity into concept-owned case modules when next touched.
S3 wire-surface suite plus its in-memory tenant, blob, and metadata fakes; move the fakes into a support module and split cases by operation family when next touched.
Node compatibility-target capability suite; split by builtin module family (events, buffer, assert, crypto, dgram) when next touched.
Workload-ingress suite plus its process network-authority guard and ingress-source fakes; split fakes from cases and cases by ingress phase when next touched.
Workload-composition suite with its effect-forbidden provider fakes and tenant recovery cuts; move fakes into a support module when next touched.
Workload-saga transition suite; split provision, restart, and teardown cases to match the saga/state child modules when next touched.
Custom-harness benchmark that replays one captured batch distribution through layered SQLite write paths; never ships and keeps one measurement story.
Per-tenant committer lease owns acquisition, renewal clock, and lease status transitions with its contract tests; split renewal from acquisition if it grows.
LibSQL replica provider suite keeps scheduler fencing and commit-acknowledgement fault cases on one provider interface.
Host lifecycle root owns the systemd backend trait and unit naming; activation, restart, and teardown already live in child modules.
SQLite journal suite keeps commit-entry, pending-prefix, and document-version recovery invariants together; observability and PPSC cases are already children.
Dialect-shared SQL store orchestration sits above sql/write_core; one layer contract shared by every SQL provider.
Batch-reservation lifetime suite owns plan-batch identity and scalar-versus-plan fencing cases; recovery fencing is already a child.
Port-lease lifecycle suite; adopted replay, claim-required, and tenant quota cases are already children. Split stop-rebind cases out if it grows.
Port-lease root owns portable lease identity and durable lifecycle state; binding, error, operation, plan batch, rebind, and request already live in child modules.
Whole node:perf_hooks module surface on the restricted loader override path; deno_web supplies only the web Performance base, so the Node types stay here until they move into the fork.
Node compatibility resolver owns scoped npm package checks, node_modules resolution, and their typed denial errors.
CLI staged composition of one local OS-node network authority; orders existing seams and owns no effects. Forwarded composition is already a child.
Compose retirement suite with its recording provider and static catalog fakes; one retirement contract.
Forwarded machine provision suite; teardown substitution is already a child.
Parent-host exact-phase adapter for compute-confirmed machine workloads; teardown authority is already a child.
Confirmed machine publication journal owns its separate format and directory; retirement and stop barrier are already children.
Per-workload PEP owns configuration, preparation, and serving; health and policy reload are already children.
Node-scoped egress engine composition root owns the shared substrate and the per-workload PEP lifecycle registry.
Tenant-isolation drift scanner owns scan configuration, the report, and per-surface violation detection as one audit contract.
Server construction owns serve options, shutdown handles, and the serve entry points; split leased serving out if it grows.
Test-only deep module by design: its barriers, saga store, capability providers, fixtures, and ten behavioral cases share private injected authorities (see the module doc).
Firestore REST CRUD suite owns commit, batch get, transform, and transaction-token cases on one REST interface.
Cloud Functions HTTP handler and its contract tests; callable, invocation, response, and tenant concepts are already children.
Server adapter between durable port authority and Tokio listener effects; restart retain and terminal settlement are already children.
Machine API wire suite owns path encoding and strict DTO round-trip contracts.
Single-item operations (PutItem, GetItem, DeleteItem, UpdateItem) share one atomic single-item transaction plan and its contract tests.
Workload projection suite with its recording provider and sink fakes; one projection contract.
Resource provision suite with its native saga store fake; one provision contract.
Transport-free ComputeState owns the engine handle, deployment snapshot, and workload composition config with its tests.
Workload network-plan compilation suite; one compiler contract with shared sovereignty and decision fixtures.
Shared fixtures, event log, and fakes for the resource-retirement case modules beside it.
OCI egress PEP suite; post-activation cleanup, readiness, and registration failure are already children.
Shared per-sandbox egress PEP lifecycle; cleanup, process, readiness, assignment, and reload are already children.
OCI port lease coordinator root; authority, batch state, publication, machine, and Netavark lifetime are already children.
OCI port lifecycle suite; batch classification, machine cleanup, Netavark cleanup, and teardown progress are already children.
Container launch cleanup suite owns runner execution ownership and owner-death fencing cases.
Container-owned lifecycle for provider-managed machine port proxies, including partial-start cleanup.
Prepared plan-only workload runner entry point; identity, lifecycle lock, and recovery are already children.
Durable machine port publication state machine that journals each ambiguous per-binding effect; the store is already a child.
Container planning suite owns manifest persistence, network config, and exact-claim ordering cases.
Coordinator-issued, attempt-fenced container restart phases; provider effects only, with tests in a child.
Krun bundle layout, mounts, process user, and OCI config construction with its contract tests.
Krun execution teardown suite; fresh-process and network-teardown cases are already children.
Krun execute-mode launch compensation suite; restart fencing is already a child.
Provider-command idempotency suite; async current claim and network recovery are already children.
Provider-local idempotency for compute-issued commands; current claim and prepared request are already children.
Portable workload-saga identity, evidence, and transition vocabulary with its typed errors.
Portable compiled network-plan content and validation for one workload generation.
Intrinsic validation and pure transitions for nested workload restart state.
Workload saga store port suite runs one contract against several reference store implementations.
Operator policy suite with its image-verification and external-policy fakes; one policy document contract.
